title: Power BI Roadmap: Beginner to Industry-Ready

iterations.title: Foundations
iterations.goal: By Day 30 you can take raw files, clean them, build a star schema, write core DAX measures and design a clean multi-page report on your own.
iterations.exit: Import and clean a CSV · split a flat table into fact + dimensions · build a date table and mark it · write SUM, DIVIDE, CALCULATE, YoY % measures · build a 2-page report with slicers and a consistent theme.

iterations.title: Working Analyst
iterations.goal: By Day 65 you work the way a team analyst does: automate messy data loads, model multi-table data, write intermediate DAX, design reports people enjoy using, and publish, share, refresh and secure them in the Service.
iterations.exit: Combine a folder of files with a parameterised path · explain query folding in one sentence · handle two date relationships with USERELATIONSHIP · write RANKX, rolling 3-month and closing-balance measures · fix a wrong matrix total · build drillthrough + tooltip pages · publish an app with row-level security.

iterations.title: Industry-Ready
iterations.goal: By Day 100 you can solve real business problems with advanced DAX patterns, make slow models fast, work with version control and Fabric, pass PL-300, and show three portfolio projects.
iterations.exit: Explain expanded tables and KEEPFILTERS · build a time-intelligence calculation group · cut a model's size by 30%+ and show before/after in DAX Studio · save a project as PBIP and push it to GitHub · score 80%+ on the official PL-300 practice assessment · present your capstone in 5 minutes.

days.title: What Power BI is
days.subtopics: Desktop vs Service vs Mobile; the workflow get → transform → model → visualize → share; what a BI analyst does daily
days.learn: What is Power BI, What is Desktop
days.practice: Create your folder structure. Open Desktop, load the Financial Sample via Use sample data. Click through Report, Table, Model and DAX query views.

days.title: Getting data
days.subtopics: Excel, CSV, folder sources; Navigator; Load vs Transform; Import vs DirectQuery (just the idea)
days.learn: Connect to data, Data sources list
days.practice: Download Financial Sample.xlsx and import it manually. Import one CSV of your choice.

days.title: Power Query Editor tour
days.subtopics: Ribbon, Applied Steps, formula bar, data types, rename, remove columns, filter rows, Close & Apply
days.learn: What is Power Query, Power Query UI
days.practice: On Financial Sample: fix data types, remove 2 columns, rename columns to plain English, filter out one segment. Delete a step and re-add it.

days.title: First visuals
days.subtopics: Column/bar, line, card, table vs matrix, slicer; Format pane basics; titles
days.learn: Visual types, Excel to stunning report tutorial
days.practice: Follow the tutorial end to end.

days.title: First DAX measures
days.subtopics: Implicit vs explicit measures; SUM, AVERAGE, COUNTROWS, DISTINCTCOUNT, DIVIDE; why pros always write explicit measures
days.practice: Write: Total Sales, Total Profit, Profit Margin % (with DIVIDE), Order Count. Use them in cards.

days.title: Filters and interactions
days.subtopics: Visual, page and report filters; cross-filter vs cross- highlight; Edit interactions; sorting
days.practice: Add a page filter and a report filter. Stop one chart from filtering another.

days.title: Review & Build
days.practice: From a blank file, rebuild a 1-page "Financial Overview": 4 KPI cards, a trend line, a bar by country, 2 slicers. Time yourself.

days.title: Data profiling
days.subtopics: Column quality, distribution, profile; profiling on full dataset vs top 1,000 rows; nulls and errors
days.learn: Data profiling tools, Dealing with errors
days.practice: Download a table from data.gov.in. Turn on profiling; list every quality issue you see in your notes.

days.title: Text cleaning
days.subtopics: Trim, Clean, case, split by delimiter, extract, replace values, Column from Examples
days.learn: Split by delimiter, Replace values, Column from examples
days.practice: Fix the text issues from Day 8. Split a full name or address column.

days.title: Numbers, dates, new columns
days.subtopics: Data types and locale (Indian dd-mm-yyyy dates!); custom column; conditional column
days.learn: Data types, Custom column, Conditional column
days.practice: Add a "Profit Band" conditional column. Fix a date column using Using locale.

days.title: Reshaping
days.subtopics: Tidy data idea; unpivot, pivot, transpose; promote headers
days.practice: Download a World Bank indicator (years as columns). Unpivot it to Country · Year · Value.

days.title: Combining tables
days.subtopics: Merge = join (left, right, inner, full, anti); Append = stack; matching key types
days.practice: Download Superstore. Merge Orders with Returns (left outer) to flag returned orders. Use a left anti join to find orders never returned. Append two years of data.

days.title: Grouping and organising
days.subtopics: Group By (multiple aggregations); Reference vs Duplicate; disable load for helper queries; query folders and naming
days.practice: Group Superstore by Region and Category. Organise queries into folders: Staging, Dimensions, Facts.

days.title: Review & Build
days.practice: Take one fresh messy data.gov.in file and clean it fully. Every step renamed meaningfully (pros do this).

days.title: Why modeling
days.subtopics: Fact vs dimension tables; grain; star schema vs one big flat table
days.learn: Star schema guidance (read twice; it's the most important page in this plan)
days.practice: On paper, sketch Superstore as one fact table and 4 dimensions.

days.title: Relationships
days.subtopics: One-to- many, one-to-one, many-to- many; cross-filter direction; active vs inactive; Model view
days.practice: Turn off Autodetect relationships. Create them yourself and check direction arrows.

days.title: Build a star schema from a flat file
days.subtopics: Reference the flat table → keep dimension columns → remove duplicates → relate back
days.practice: Split Superstore into Sales (fact), Customer, Product, Geography, Date. Hide fact-table keys.

days.title: Date table
days.subtopics: Why you need one; CALENDAR vs CALENDARAUTO vs Power Query; mark as date table; turn off Auto date/time
days.learn: Date table guidance, Mark as date table, Auto date/time
days.practice: Build a DAX date table with Year, Quarter, Month name, Month number, Weekday. Add an Indian Financial Year column (April–March).

days.title: Model properties
days.subtopics: Sort by column (month names!), data categories (city, state), formats, default summarization, hierarchies, display folders, hiding columns
days.practice: Sort Month Name by Month Number. Create a Year → Quarter → Month hierarchy. Set State as a geography category and try a map.

days.title: Calculated columns vs measures
days.subtopics: When each is right; memory cost; a dedicated Measures table
days.learn: Calculated columns, SQLBI: columns vs measures
days.practice: Create an empty "_Measures" table and move every measure into it.

days.title: Review & Build
days.practice: Download Maven Toys from the Data Playground. Model it as a star schema with a date table, from scratch.

days.title: DAX syntax
days.subtopics: Operators, data types, BLANK, comments, formatting conventions; aggregators (SUM) vs iterators (SUMX)
days.learn: DAX overview, SQLBI DAX formatting rules
days.practice: Write Sales = SUMX(Sales, Quantity × Price). Paste all your measures into DAX Formatter.

days.title: Evaluation context (the big idea)
days.subtopics: Row context vs filter context; why the same measure gives different numbers in each cell
days.practice: In a matrix, explain out loud why each cell shows what it shows. Write it in your notes.

days.title: CALCULATE
days.subtopics: Adding filters, replacing filters, boolean filters; why it's the most important DAX function
days.practice: Write: Sales West, Sales Technology, Sales West + Technology, Sales for discounted orders.

days.title: Removing filters
days.subtopics: ALL, ALLEXCEPT, REMOVEFILTERS; % of total; % of category
days.practice: Write % of Grand Total and % of Category. Check both in a matrix by Category → Sub- category.

days.title: Logic and variables
days.subtopics: IF, SWITCH(TRUE()), ISBLANK, COALESCE; VAR … RETURN for readable code
days.practice: Rewrite Profit Margin % using VAR. Write a "Performance Flag" measure (Above target / On track / Below).

days.title: Basic time intelligence
days.subtopics: TOTALYTD, SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR, DATEADD; YoY and YoY %
days.practice: Write Sales YTD, Sales LY, YoY, YoY %. Also Sales FYTD for the Indian April– March year.

days.title: Review & Build
days.practice: Build a KPI page: Sales, Profit, Margin %, YoY %, YTD, % of total, each in its own card or matrix.

days.title: Report design basics
days.subtopics: Layout grid, visual hierarchy (KPIs top-left), choosing visuals, consistent colors, themes, titles that say something
days.practice: Start Project 1: "Superstore Sales Overview", 2 pages (Executive summary, Product deep-dive).

days.title: Finish and self-review
days.practice: Finish Project 1. Save to 04_Portfolio/ . Take 3 screenshots. Write a 5-line summary of insights you found.

days.title: Combine files from a folder
days.subtopics: Folder connector, sample file, helper queries, why this is used for monthly reports
days.practice: Split Superstore into 12 monthly CSVs (in Excel). Load them all with one Folder query. Add a 13th file and refresh: it should just appear.

days.title: Parameters and data source settings
days.subtopics: Dynamic file paths; credentials; privacy levels and why they cause errors
days.practice: Replace the hard-coded folder path with a parameter. Change the parameter and refresh.

days.title: M language basics
days.subtopics: Advanced Editor; let … in; steps as variables; values, lists, records, tables
days.practice: Open the Advanced Editor on Day 31's query. Rename every step and add a comment explaining each.

days.title: Custom functions and error handling
days.subtopics: Turn a query into a function; try … otherwise; Keep/Remove errors; fixing import errors
days.practice: Write a function that cleans a phone or PIN code column. Use try … otherwise to replace bad dates with null.

days.title: Review & Build
days.practice: Download Contoso 10K CSV. Load all tables, clean types, organise into query folders, and document each query's purpose in its description.

days.title: Semi-structured data
days.subtopics: JSON, XML, web tables; expanding records and lists into a table
days.learn: JSON connector, Parse JSON/XML, Web page tutorial
days.practice: Import a Wikipedia table (e.g. Indian states by GDP). Expand a nested JSON sample into a flat table.
days.groupTitle: Semi-structured data, storage modes, modeling in depth

days.title: Query folding
days.subtopics: What it is; which steps fold; folding indicators; View Native Query; why it matters for big data
days.practice: Read only (files don't fold). If you've installed SQL Server for your SQL course, connect to it and watch the indicators.
days.groupTitle: Semi-structured data, storage modes, modeling in depth

days.title: Storage modes
days.subtopics: Import vs DirectQuery vs Dual vs Direct Lake; composite models; when each is chosen at work
days.practice: Write a comparison table in your notes: speed, freshness, size limit, DAX limitations. This is a top interview question.
days.groupTitle: Semi-structured data, storage modes, modeling in depth

days.title: Role-playing dimensions
days.subtopics: Order Date vs Delivery Date; active vs inactive relationships; USERELATIONSHIP
days.practice: In Contoso, relate Date to both Order Date and Delivery Date. Write Sales by Delivery Date.
days.groupTitle: Semi-structured data, storage modes, modeling in depth

days.title: Many-to-many and bidirectional filters
days.subtopics: Bridge tables; why bidirectional is risky (ambiguity, performance)
days.practice: Model a budget table at Month × Category grain against daily sales.
days.groupTitle: Semi-structured data, storage modes, modeling in depth

days.title: Keys and granularity
days.subtopics: Surrogate keys (Index column); snowflake vs star (when to flatten); choosing the grain
days.learn: Star schema guidance (reread sections on surrogate keys and snowflake)
days.practice: Flatten Product → Subcategory → Category into one Product dimension.
days.groupTitle: Semi-structured data, storage modes, modeling in depth

days.title: Review & Build
days.practice: Finish the full Contoso star schema: role-playing dates, hidden keys, sorted columns, hierarchies, measures table.
days.groupTitle: Semi-structured data, storage modes, modeling in depth

days.title: Iterators
days.subtopics: SUMX, AVERAGEX, MINX/MAXX, COUNTX; RANKX and ties; Top N
days.learn: dax.guide/sumx, dax.guide/rankx, SQLBI: RANKX in measures
days.practice: Write Average Order Value, Product Rank by Sales, Top 5 Products.

days.title: Context transition
days.subtopics: What happens when CALCULATE meets row context; RELATED, RELATEDTABLE
days.practice: Calculated column on Customer: Lifetime Sales. Then explain why it needs CALCULATE.

days.title: Table functions
days.subtopics: VALUES, DISTINCT, FILTER, ADDCOLUMNS, SUMMARIZECOLUMNS, TOPN, SELECTCOLUMNS
days.practice: Open DAX query view and run EVALUATE on each function to see the table it returns.

days.title: Time intelligence in depth
days.subtopics: MTD/QTD; rolling 3 and 12 months (DATESINPERIOD); moving averages; Indian fiscal year (April–March)
days.practice: Write Sales MTD, Rolling 12M Sales, 3-Month Moving Average, Sales FYTD with year end "3/31".

days.title: Semi-additive measures
days.subtopics: Stock and balances: can't be summed over time; closing balance, LASTNONBLANK
days.practice: With Maven Toys inventory: Closing Stock, Average Stock, Stock Days Cover. Very relevant to retail roles.

days.title: Totals and selections
days.subtopics: SELECTEDVALUE, HASONEVALUE, ISINSCOPE; fixing wrong totals; dynamic titles; basic statistics (MEDIAN, STDEV)
days.learn: dax.guide/selectedvalue, dax.guide/isinscope, Expression- based titles, Statistical functions
days.practice: Build a title that reads "Sales for <selected region>". Fix a matrix total that sums when it should average.

days.title: Review & Build
days.practice: DAX drill: write 20 measures from memory (list in your notes). Check each against a manual Excel pivot.

days.title: Choosing the right visual
days.subtopics: Comparison, trend, part-to- whole, distribution, relationship; what to avoid (3D, too many pies)
days.practice: Critique your Iteration 1 report: list every visual you'd change and why.

days.title: Conditional formatting and analytics
days.subtopics: Background/font colors, data bars, icons, field- value rules; reference lines, constant lines, trend lines
days.practice: Red/green YoY % in a matrix. Add a target line to a column chart.

days.title: Drill down and drillthrough
days.subtopics: Hierarchy drilling; drillthrough pages, Back button, keep all filters
days.practice: Build a Customer Detail page you can drill through to from any customer name.

days.title: Interactivity
days.subtopics: Report page tooltips; bookmarks; Selection pane (group, layer, hide); buttons and actions
days.practice: Make a tooltip page with a mini trend. Use bookmarks to toggle chart ↔ table view.

days.title: Slicers and dynamic visuals
days.subtopics: Sync slicers across pages; field parameters (user picks the measure/dimension); page navigator
days.learn: Slicers and sync, Field parameters, Navigators
days.practice: Add a field parameter so users switch between Sales, Profit and Units in one chart.

days.title: Polish, mobile, accessibility
days.subtopics: Theme JSON; wireframing; mobile layout; alt text, tab order, color contrast
days.practice: Create a custom theme JSON. Build a mobile layout for your summary page.

days.title: Review & Build
days.practice: Redesign Project 1 from scratch with everything from this week. Compare before/after screenshots.

days.title: Service basics
days.subtopics: Publish; My workspace; semantic model vs report vs dashboard; licenses (Free, Pro, PPU, Fabric capacity) at a high level
days.practice: Publish your Contoso report. Explore the semantic model settings page.

days.title: Workspaces, roles, sharing
days.subtopics: Admin/Member/Contributor/Viewer; share vs app vs Teams; item-level access
days.practice: Create a workspace and an app with two reports.

days.title: Dashboards, alerts, subscriptions
days.subtopics: Pinning tiles; dashboard vs report (interview favourite); data alerts; email subscriptions
days.practice: Pin 4 tiles to a dashboard; set an alert on a KPI card.

days.title: Refresh and gateways
days.subtopics: Scheduled refresh; when a gateway is needed; personal vs standard gateway; cloud sources
days.learn: Scheduled refresh, What is a gateway
days.practice: Move your data to OneDrive for Business or SharePoint so it refreshes without a gateway. Schedule a daily refresh.

days.title: Row-level security
days.subtopics: Static roles; dynamic RLS with USERPRINCIPALNAME and a security table; testing with View as
days.practice: Create a role per region, then a dynamic version driven by a user– region mapping table.

days.title: Governance
days.subtopics: Promote vs certify; sensitivity labels; lineage view; export settings
days.practice: Open lineage view for your workspace and explain each item in your notes.

days.title: Review & Build
days.practice: End-to-end: publish Contoso, set refresh, add RLS, package as an app.

days.title: Project 2: "Retail Sales & Inventory Performance" (Maven Toys)
days.practice: Requirements (5 business questions), model, measures including stock cover and rolling sales.

days.title: Finish and publish
days.practice: 3 pages + drillthrough + tooltip page. Publish, screenshot, write insights. Run the exit check.

days.title: Filter propagation in depth
days.subtopics: Expanded tables; filter overwrite vs intersection; KEEPFILTERS
days.practice: Write the same measure with and without KEEPFILTERS; explain the difference in a matrix.

days.title: Advanced filter functions
days.subtopics: ALLSELECTED (% of visible total); CROSSFILTER; TREATAS for virtual relationships
days.practice: % of selected total; connect the budget table with TREATAS instead of a relationship.

days.title: Calculation groups
days.subtopics: Why they replace dozens of measures; time- intelligence calc group; format strings; dynamic format strings
days.practice: Build a calc group with Current, PY, YoY, YoY %, YTD. Apply it to Sales, Profit and Units.

days.title: Visual calculations, window functions, DAX query view
days.subtopics: OFFSET, INDEX, WINDOW; EVALUATE / DEFINE queries
days.learn: Visual calculations, DAX query view, dax.guide/offset
days.practice: Running total and month-over-month change using a visual calculation; then the same with OFFSET in a measure.

days.title: Review & Build
days.practice: Rewrite your 10 most complex measures more cleanly (VARs, comments, formatting).

days.title: ABC / Pareto analysis and Top N with "Others"
days.subtopics: Which 20% of products make 80% of sales
days.practice: ABC class per product; a Pareto chart (cumulative %).

days.title: Customer analytics
days.subtopics: New vs returning customers; repeat rate; simple cohort retention
days.learn: DAX Patterns: new and returning customers
days.practice: New Customers, Returning Customers, Repeat Rate %. (Think: Lenskart repeat eyewear buyers.)

learnLinks.text: DAX Patterns: new and returning customers

days.title: Budget vs actual
days.subtopics: Different granularity; allocating monthly targets to days; variance and achievement %
days.practice: Monthly store targets vs daily sales; achievement % with conditional formatting.

days.title: What-if and segmentation
days.subtopics: What-if parameters ("What if price rises 5%?"); dynamic segmentation by customer spend
days.learn: What-if parameters, DAX Patterns: dynamic segmentation
days.practice: Discount scenario slider; customer segments (Low/Mid/High value) that update with filters.

days.title: Indian formatting and disconnected tables
days.subtopics: Lakhs/crores display; unit switcher (₹, ₹ L, ₹ Cr) with a disconnected table and dynamic format strings
days.practice: Slicer that switches all KPIs between ₹, Lakhs and Crores. Indian employers notice this.

days.title: Debugging DAX
days.subtopics: DAX Studio basics; Server Timings; common mistakes (wrong context, bidirectional surprises, BLANK handling)
days.learn: DAX Studio docs, DAX query view
days.practice: Install DAX Studio; connect to your model; capture a slow measure and time it.

days.title: Review & Build
days.practice: Answer 10 business questions from Contoso using only measures (write the questions first, as a manager would).

days.practice: Record a page refresh; find the slowest visual and fix it.

days.title: VertiPaq and model size
days.subtopics: Columnar storage, cardinality, compression; remove unused columns, reduce precision, split date- time
days.practice: Load Contoso 1M rows. Use VertiPaq Analyzer (DAX Studio) to record size, then reduce it. Log before/after.

days.title: Large-data features
days.subtopics: Incremental refresh; aggregations; DirectQuery performance tips
days.practice: Configure incremental refresh policy (RangeStart/RangeEnd) on the Sales table.

days.practice: Run BPA on your model; fix every high-severity warning.

days.practice: Save your Contoso project as PBIP, create a GitHub repo, commit, change a measure, commit again and view the diff.
